h: Four Expressions Reveal the Holiness of the Seventh Day

p: אַתָּה קִדַּשְׁתָּ אֶת יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי לִשְׁמֶךָ
"You sanctified the seventh day for Your Name,
the purpose of the making of heaven and earth;
You blessed it, etc., and sanctified it, etc."
mentioned in the Torah about Shabbos (Bereishis 2:2–3):
"And God finished on the seventh day, etc.,"
"and He rested on the seventh day, etc.,"
"and He blessed, etc.," "and He sanctified, etc."
corresponds to "And God finished on the seventh day,"
מָשָׁל לְמֶלֶךְ שֶׁעָשָׂה לוֹ חוּפָּה וְכוּלֵּי
"A parable of a king who made himself a wedding canopy, etc.;
and what was lacking? A bride, etc."
It expounds "vayechal" as an expression of "kallah," bride,
for Shabbos is called a bride,
That is, on Shabbos Yisrael are called
just as they were called at the time of Matan Torah;
Yisrael are called by the name of bride.
when all Yisrael accept upon themselves
the yoke of His kingship, yisbarach Shemo,
Yisrael are called by the title of bride.
as it says in Sefer Abudraham.
"The purpose of the making of heaven and earth"
corresponds to "and He rested on the seventh day,"
that Hashem Yisbarach had from the Creation
which is the purpose of the making of heaven and earth;
accept the yoke of His kingship,
and "the awe of Shabbos is upon an am ha'aretz,"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ יְרוּשַׁלְמִי פֶּרֶק ד דִּדְמַאי
as stated in Yerushalmi, chapter 4 of Demai (Demai 4:1);
וְלֹא בָרָא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אֶת עוֹלָמוֹ
and "HaKadosh Baruch Hu created His world only
so that they should fear Him, etc."
and elsewhere (end of the chapter Kinyan Torah, Avos 6:11):
כָּל מַה שֶּׁבָּרָא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא בְּעוֹלָמוֹ
"Everything that HaKadosh Baruch Hu created in His world
He created only for His glory,
'Everyone that is called by My Name, etc.'"
And that is on the day of Shabbos,
as we say: "On the seventh day
He ascended and sat upon His Throne of Glory."
"and You sanctified it above all, etc."
And they correspond to the four holinesses
for it is the aspect of Atika Kadisha,
(וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ יִתְרוֹ פח, א)
(as it says in the holy Zohar, Yisro 88a);
and also the aspect of Yesod,
for "the body and the covenant are reckoned as one"
(וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּרַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא פִּנְחָס רמב, ב)
(as it says in the Ra'aya Mehemna, Pinchas 242b).
corresponds to the holiness of Chakal Tapuchin,
which is the souls of Yisrael,
since they were likened to an apple
and not a day of the body
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב רה, א)
for on Shabbos the Jew casts off
and he is free only for Torah and avodah,
"The soul of man is the lamp of Hashem";
and this is the meaning of "for Your Name."
"The purpose of the making of heaven and earth"
corresponds to the holiness of Atika Kadisha,
for the sake of Yisrael, who are called "reishis,"
to the beginning of the Thought;
and this corresponds to "and He rested on the seventh day,"
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (סֵדֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ רַבָּה רֵישׁ פֶּרֶק א)
as they said (Seder Eliyahu Rabbah, beginning of chapter 1):
"Days were formed, and one of them is His"
this is the day of Shabbos for Yisrael;
שֶׁזֶּה הָיָה תַּכְלִית מַעֲשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ
for this was the purpose of the making of heaven and earth,
that there should be a Jewish nation,
and they should accept upon themselves the yoke of His kingship
"and He blessed" corresponds to the holiness of Yesod,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קלה, ב)
as it says in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 135b):
"This is the channel of blessings, etc.;
in the secret of the sign of the covenant
it is the spring of the well, etc.";
and in Pasach Eliyahu (Tikkunei Zohar, Introduction 17a):
corresponds to the holiness of Zeir Anpin,
"You shall be holy, for I am holy":
for the holiness of Yisrael comes
from their being attached to Hashem Yisbarach,
and that is the aspect of Zeir Anpin.
And with "and He finished, etc." and "and He rested, etc.,"
it is written with each one
whereas with "and He blessed" and "and He sanctified,"
which correspond to Yesod and Zeir Anpin,
נֶאֱמַר רַק פַּעַם אַחַת בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי
"the seventh day" is said only once:
for the body and the covenant are reckoned as one,
And holiness and blessing are one,
כִּי שָׁם צִוָּה ה׳ אֶת הַבְּרָכָה
of whom it is written (Divrei HaYamim I 23:13),
"And Aharon was set apart, to sanctify him as holy of holies"
to them were given the blessings,
